description: NaVCAsO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.57 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-2.01 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.23 Å) and two longer (1.34 Å) C-O bond lengths. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-48°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.74 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one V, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one As atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one V and one As atom.
